plugin.name: Services
plugin.description: Manage services, timers and logs on your hosts over SSH.

use.title: Use Services
use.description: Open the Services tab on hosts you can reach. Changes also need edit access to the host.

enable.label: Services
enable.description: Show the Services tab for this host to manage systemd services, timers and logs.

useSudo.label: Use sudo
useSudo.description: Run changes and protected reads with passwordless sudo when the login is not root.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Allow reading services and logs, but block every change from Termix.

logPaths.label: Log folders
logPaths.description: Folders the Log files view may read, separated by commas.

showPanel.label: Panel beside the terminal
showPanel.description: Offer a services panel next to this host's SSH terminal.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the services panel with a terminal
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the services panel when a terminal opens on a host that has it.

companionSide.label: Services panel side
companionSide.description: Where the panel sits next to the terminal.

companionSize.label: Services panel size
companionSize.description: Width, or height at the bottom, in pixels.

companionEdgeButton.label: Services panel edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the terminal edge to open the panel.

tab.title: Services
tab.noHost: Pick a host to manage its services.
tab.error: Could not read services on this host.
tab.disabled: Services is not turned on for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.sudo: Changes need a root login or passwordless sudo. Run sudo -n true on the host to check.
tab.noInitHint: This host has no systemd or OpenRC that Termix can use. Log files still work.

units.confirmStopDesc: Anything that needs it may stop working until it starts again.

confirmDesc.stop: Anything that needs it may stop working until it starts again.
confirmDesc.disable: It keeps running now, but won't start after a reboot.
confirmDesc.disable-now: It stops now and won't start after a reboot.
confirmDesc.mask: A masked unit can't be started at all, by hand or by other units, until you unmask it.
confirmDesc.revert: This removes drop-ins and local copies of the unit, and puts back the version from the package.

watch.on: You will get an alert when {{unit}} fails

editor.loadFailed: Could not read the unit file.
editor.overrideHint: An override is a drop-in file that changes only the lines you put here. Updates to the package keep working. Leave it empty and save to remove it.
editor.overrideTemplate: Lines here add to or replace the unit's own settings
editor.localHint: This unit file lives in /etc/systemd/system, so it is yours to edit.
editor.vendorHint: This unit comes from a package ({{path}}). Saving the full file puts a copy in /etc/systemd/system that wins over it. Revert removes the copy again.
editor.notWritable: Files can't be written for this kind of unit.
editor.saveFailed: Not saved. The check failed or the file could not be written.
editor.combined: Everything systemd reads for this unit
editor.deleteDesc: It stops, won't start at boot, and its file and drop-ins are removed.

create.title: New service
create.name: Name
create.commandHint: The full path to the program, then its arguments.
create.timerHint: Make a timer that runs the command at set times instead of keeping it running.
create.scheduleHint: An OnCalendar value, like daily, hourly or Mon *-*-* 03:00:00.
create.afterHint: Units to wait for, separated by spaces.
create.enableHint: For a schedule this turns on the timer.

journal.vacuumDesc: Journal entries older than 4 weeks are deleted from the host.

files.roots: From {{roots}}. Change the folders in the host settings.
files.loadFailed: Could not list the log files.

card.title: Watched services
card.empty: No watched services. Use the bell next to a service to watch it.
